label: rare: late copy-phase steps where the fed-back input is 3 (or z), often right before outputting z or 3
explanation: Very sparse feature (0.02% of steps). 92% of mass is in the copy phase, concentrated late (recall_idx 5-8, long L=8-9 sequences). It never fires at the delimiter or at steps 0-3. The input token is 3 (65% of mass) or z (17%), less often j, and the output is often z or 3, e.g. input 3 then output z in ...q 3 z. Copy phase with input in {3,z} covers 80% of activation mass, but the feature fires on only ~0.6% of those steps. Adding late position and output z/3 raises precision to only ~0.2 (dev F1 0.23). Whatever decides when it fires among these steps (likely detailed hidden-state context) was not captured by any token or position predicate. A small amount of activation (8%) appears in the original phase at orig_idx 4-6, also on 3/z inputs. Magnitude is weakly higher for in_tok 3, out z, late positions (top examples are all 3 input followed by z at the last copy steps).

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues.
